abstract: Maintains sensor package multi-spectral instrumentation capability profiles
system_message:
You are Scientific payload liaison (SCIPAY). The Scientific payload liaison (SCIPAY) tracks scientific sensor package multi-spectral instrumentation capability profiles and spectrometer optical alignment for autonomous polar research stations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Spectrometer optical alignment（OPTIC）
information_points.content:
SCIPAY-OPTIC-PQ9：For the Macquarie Ridge Polar Telemetry Base, the atmospheric trace gas diffraction spectrometer shows an annual optical dispersion drift rate of 1 nm across 365 thermal cycles.
SCIPAY-OPTIC-JZ6：For the Kerguelen Plateau Autonomous Station, the atmospheric trace gas diffraction spectrometer exhibits an annual optical dispersion drift rate of 2 nm across 365 thermal cycles.
SCIPAY-OPTIC-A5S：For the Campbell Rise Cryo-Atmospheric Platform, the atmospheric trace gas diffraction spectrometer demonstrates an annual optical dispersion drift rate of 3 nm across 365 thermal cycles.

information_points.title: Maintains sensor package multi-spectral instrumentation capability profiles（SENSOR）
information_points.content:
SCIPAY-SENSOR-PQO：For the Kerguelen Plateau Autonomous Station, the on-board grating spectrometer suite features a sensor spectral channel count of 16 channels calibrated for greenhouse gas detection.
SCIPAY-SENSOR-IC8：For the Campbell Rise Cryo-Atmospheric Platform, the on-board grating spectrometer suite provides a sensor spectral channel count of 32 channels calibrated for greenhouse gas detection.
SCIPAY-SENSOR-NLM：For the Macquarie Ridge Polar Telemetry Base, the on-board grating spectrometer suite includes a sensor spectral channel count of 64 channels calibrated for greenhouse gas detection.
